issues.title: Some users may have been unable to open or upload attachments in the new Outlook client
issues.current: A post-incident report has been published.

issues.title: Some users may be unable to send calendar invitations in Exchange Online
issues.impact: Users may have been unable to send calendar invitations in Exchange Online.
issues.current: Following the initiating of our aforementioned fix across the affected environment, we’ve confirmed with a subset of users and our monitoring telemetry that impact has been fully resolved.
issues.scope: This issue may have impacted some users who attempted to send calendar invitations in Exchange Online due to hitting a recipient limit of 25 users.

issues.title: Admins may encounter delays in accessing audit log data results in Microsoft Purview Audit
issues.impact: Admins may encounter delays in accessing audit log data results in Microsoft Purview Audit.
issues.current: The process of draining the backlog of affected events is progressing, and affected users should experience impact relief as the remaining events are processed. We’re continuing to monitor service telemetry to ensure the process completes and will provide an estimation for the completion of this process when available.
issues.scope: Any admin attempting to access audit log data from Microsoft Purview Audit may be affected. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

issues.title: Users may be unable to view contacts and Speed Dial entries in Microsoft Teams, Outlook desktop and mobile
issues.impact: Users may have been unable to view contacts and Speed Dial entries in Microsoft Teams, Outlook desktop and mobile.
issues.current: We’ve completed deployment of the code fix to repair the remaining affected contacts on a user basis and confirmed that impact is remediated. Some contacts may still be blank; however, we're unable to automate a fix to resolve all instances of blank contacts. We recommend users to delete the blank contacts and add them again. If they add a contact from a profile card, all information that was previously visible should return: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/outlook/create-view-and-edit-contacts-and-contact-lists-in-outlook
issues.scope: Some users attempting to view contacts and Speed Dial entries in Microsoft Teams, Outlook desktop and mobile may have been impacted.

issues.title: Some users may see delays receiving policies, apps, and other changes on Windows devices enrolled in Microsoft Intune
issues.impact: Users may see delays receiving policies, apps, and other changes on Windows devices enrolled in Microsoft Intune.
issues.current: We anticipate that our fix will be available by our next scheduled communication. We'll continue to monitor deployment and provide any updates to this remediation timeline as soon as they become available.
issues.scope: Some users with Windows devices enrolled in Microsoft Intune may experience delays receiving policies, apps, and other changes while their devices install Windows security update MSRC144654. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

issues.title: Some users may be unable to view organization information in multiple Microsoft 365 services
issues.impact: Users may be unable to view organization information in multiple Microsoft 365 services.
issues.current: We've identified two potential mitigation options and are determining which will be the safest and most effective. We'll provide additional information on the resolution timeline based on the results of our analysis by our next scheduled communications update.
issues.scope: This issue may affect some users who are attempting to view organization information in multiple Microsoft 365 services are impacted. This section may be updated as our investigation progresses.

issues.title: Users may not see Public Switched Telephone Network (PSTN) contact names shown on inbound Microsoft Teams call banners
issues.impact: Users may not see Public Switched Telephone Network (PSTN) contact names shown on inbound Microsoft Teams call banners.
issues.current: We've determined that a recent change introduced an incorrect configuration affecting how PSTN contact names are displayed for inbound Microsoft Teams calls. We're developing a fix to correct this configuration and expect it to deploy by our next communication update.
issues.scope: This event may impact any user expecting to see PSTN contact names on inbound Microsoft Teams call banners. This section may be updated as our investigation progresses.

issues.title: Admins may notice delays with certain reports in the Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Teams admin centers
issues.impact: Admins may have noticed delays with certain reports in the Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Teams admin centers.
issues.current: Following the deployment of our fix, our internal service telemetry has verified that request generation and processing has returned to expected levels, and that the impact has been remediated.
issues.scope: Any admin expecting either of the affected reports from Sunday, November 22, 2026, were affected.

issues.title: Users may be unable to open Microsoft 365 Copilot in Microsoft Teams meetings on the iOS app
issues.impact: Users may have been unable to open Copilot in Microsoft Teams meetings on the iOS app.
issues.current: We've found that impact was specific to users that had the Copilot policy configured and the transcription policy configured off. Affected users also had meetings setup in Copilot using the "Only during the meeting" mode. We also determined that there was a code issue in the Microsoft Teams app version 8.20.0, which prevented the Copilot service from starting. After releasing the Microsoft Teams app versions 8.21.0 and above, which contains the fix, we confirmed that it successful remediates the impact. The updated version is available for all affected users in the Apple App Store and in order to obtain the fix, users need to manually install the updated version.
issues.scope: Users who had the Copilot policy configured to "On," the transcription policy configured to "Off," and had meetings setup in Copilot using the "Only during the meeting" mode may have been impacted.
